name: Raccoons to Riches
detailed_description:
Raccoons to Riches is a Roguelike Deckbuilding game about running a fantasy Item Shop and proving yourself as a budding entrepreneur!

You're a little Raccoon in the big world, and you've gotta make rent! Assemble your stock of Item and Business Tactic cards! Hustle your way to incredible profits! Build up your Inventory and Customer Base as you turn your humble shop into an incredible shopping destination!

Features:

Strategic Deckbuilding

Fill your Daily Inventory with valuable adventuring gear and fantasy Items that your customers will go crazy for. Specialize your shop for selling Armor, Weapons, Potions, or Food! Learn powerful Business Tactics to convince your customers to pay handsomely for your wares!

Unique Resource System 

Manage your Customers' Patience to sell them as many items as possible! Most actions cost Patience, and customers leave when they're all out, so you'd better act fast!

Make Your Shop Your Own 

Acquire powerful and fancy shop decorations to customize your Shelves, Carpet, Lighting, Workshop, and Sales Counter. They're easy on the eyes, and grant you powerful effects to further specialize your shop!

Cultivate Your Clientele 

As you fulfill your customers' needs and wants, word of your shop will spread, allowing you to attract new types of customers, or even ban unwanted customers from returning. Specialize your Customer Base to match your Shop's Items and Decorations for maximum profits!

Craft Your Way to Incredible Profits 

Craft your Items together into brand new, more valuable Items that'll please an even wider array of Customers. With a bit of elbow grease, you can make just the thing your Customers desire!

Make Rent 

We've all got bills to pay, especially here! Make sure you've got enough Gold to cover an ever-increasing amount of Weekly Payments. Can you keep up with the rising tide for a whole month and prove you've got what it takes to be a shopkeeper?

Other Cool Stuff 

Raccoons to Riches also comes with more cool features that'd you'd usually expect a game to have:

  • Stat Tracking and Achievements to track down, for the achievement-hunters out there.

  • Touchscreen support.

  • A Tutorial!

  • A big Compendium of Items, Customers, Business Tactics, and Decorations for easy reference.

  • Flavour Text for all Items, Tactics, Customers and Decorations (viewable via the Compendium, and elsewhere)

  • Windows and Linux Support

Sell Items, learn powerful Business Tactics, grow your Inventory and Customer Base, Craft new Items, and Customize your Shop to make incredible profits. Can you make rent, or will you go out of business?
